CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Public WithEvents mcTree As clsTreeview
Attribute mcTree.VB_VarHelpID = -1
Private mfrImages As MSForms.Frame
Public AppName As String

Const mcPtPixel As Single = 0.75

Private Sub CautB_Click()
If Nz(CAUT, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Ce cauti?!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    Exit Sub
End If

If Nz(IDL, -1) = -1 Then
    MsgBox "Nu ai selectat luna in care doresti sa cauti!", vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    Exit Sub
End If

Dim rs As DAO.Recordset

Set rs = Me.Grupe.Form.Recordset

rs.FindFirst "IDG = " & CAUT.Column(4)

If rs.NoMatch Then MsgBox "Copilul nu a fost gasit in prezenta!" & vbCrLf & "Poate nu este adaugat la grupa lui!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    
Me!Grupe!CL = CAUT.Column(4)

Call IncarcaPrezenta(True)

Set rs = Me.Prezenta_sub.Form.Recordset

rs.FindFirst "IDP = " & CAUT.Column(5)

If rs.NoMatch Then
    Set rs = Nothing
    Exit Sub
End If

Me!Prezenta_sub!CL = Nz(DLookup("IDZ", "Prezenta", "IDP = " & CAUT.Column(5) & " AND IDL = " & Me!IDL), 0)

If Me!Prezenta_sub!CL <> 0 Then
    IDZ = Me!Prezenta_sub!IDZ
    IDP = Me!Prezenta_sub!IDP
    Plati.Requery
End If

Set rs = Nothing

End Sub

Private Sub CautT_Change()
Select Case CautT
    Case 1
        CAUT.RowSource = CautNume.RowSource
        CAUT.ColumnWidths = CautNume.ColumnWidths
    Case 2
        CAUT.RowSource = CautCNP.RowSource
        CAUT.ColumnWidths = CautCNP.ColumnWidths
End Select

CAUT.SetFocus
CAUT.Dropdown

End Sub

Private Sub cIDV_AfterUpdate()
If CBool(DLookup("Inchisa", "LunaD", "IDL=" & IDL)) = True Then
    MsgBox "Nu se poate modifica taxa lunara pentru o luna inchisa!", vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    Exit Sub
End If

IDV = cIDV
'If MsgBox("Doresti sa stabilesti noua taxa pentru luna " & mcTree.ActiveNode.Caption & "?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbNo Then
'    MsgBox ""
If Nz(DSum("ZilePrezenta", "Prezenta", "IDL=" & Me.IDL), 0) > 0 Then
    If MsgBox("Atentie! Luna selectata are prezenta introdusa!" & vbCrLf & "Prin modificarea taxei lunare, se vor modifica si valorile lunare!" & vbCrLf & "Doresti sa continui?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbNo Then Exit Sub
    CurrentDb.Execute "UPDATE LunaD SET IDV=" & cIDV & " WHERE IDL = " & IDL
    CurrentDb.Execute "UPDATE Prezenta SET IDV=" & cIDV & ", ValoareContract=" & cIDV.Column(2) & " * ZilePrezenta, ValoareTotala=(" & cIDV.Column(2) & " * ZilePrezenta)+SI WHERE IDL = " & IDL & " AND ZilePrezenta<>0"
    Pop_luni
End If

End Sub

    Case "Plati_fact"
        If Not Plati.Form.NewRecord Then

            Plati.Form!FOC.SetFocus
        End If
        
    Case "Plati_sub"
End Select
End Sub

Private Sub Tb_Change()
Call IncarcaPlati

End Sub

Sub Pop_luni()
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------
' Procedure : Initialize
' Company   : JKP Application Development Services (c)
' Author    : Jan Karel Pieterse (www.jkp-ads.com)
' Created   : 15-01-2013
' Purpose   : Initializes the userform,
'             adds the VBA treeview to the container frame on the userform
'             and populates the treeview.
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------

Dim cRoot As clsNode
Dim cNode As clsNode


On Error GoTo Eroare

Set mcTree = Me.subTreeView.Form.pTreeview

With mcTree
    Call .NodesClear ' if reusing an exisiting treeclass

    .AppName = Me.Name
    
    .CheckBoxes(bTriState:=True) = True
    .RootButton = True
    .LabelEdit(bAutoSort:=True) = IIf(False, 0, 1)  'default 0, can be edited (like LabelEditConstants tvwAutomatic/tvwManual)
    .EnableLabelEdit(bAutoSort:=True) = False
    .FullWidth = True
    .Indentation = 14 * mcPtPixel
    .NodeHeight = 18 * mcPtPixel
    .ShowLines = True
    '.ShowExpanders = True
    .Enabled = True
    .UseScroll = Nz(UseTreeScroll, False)
    
    Call .ExpanderImage(mfrImages.Controls("MN").Picture, mfrImages.Controls("PL").Picture)
    Call .CheckboxImage(mfrImages.Controls("Unlck").Picture, mfrImages.Controls("Lck").Picture, mfrImages.Controls("Unlck").Picture)
    ' add a Root node with main and expanded icons and make it bold
    
    Dim RC As DAO.Recordset
    Dim vAnul As Integer, vLuna As Integer
    Dim Exp As Boolean
    
    Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM LunaD_L ORDER BY IDL DESC", 2)
    
    If RC.EOF Then GoTo IESIRE
    POP RC
  
    Do While Not RC.EOF
        If RC!Anul <> vAnul Then
            vAnul = RC!Anul
    
            Set cRoot = .AddRoot("A_" & RC!IDL, "Anul " & RC!Anul, "FolderClosed", "FolderOpen")
                cRoot.FontName = "Consolas"
                cRoot.FontSize = 10
                cRoot.Bold = True
                cRoot.ForeColor = RGB(0, 0, 0)
                If Not Exp Then
                    cRoot.Expanded = True
                    Exp = True
                Else
                    cRoot.Expanded = False
                End If
        End If
        
        Set cNode = cRoot.AddChild("L_" & RC!IDL, RC!LunaT & "/" & RC!Anul)
            cNode.FontName = "Consolas"
            cNode.FontSize = 9
            cNode.Bold = True
            cNode.ForeColor = IIf(RC!Inchisa, RGB(212, 34, 15), RGB(79, 148, 0))
            cNode.Expanded = False
            cNode.Checked = RC!Inchisa
            cNode.ExtraInfo = Format("01/" & RC!Luna & "/" & RC!Anul, "Short Date")
            cNode.ExtraInfoNumber = RC!IDV
            cNode.Tag = RC!IDL
        RC.MoveNext
    Loop
    
    .Refresh
End With

IESIRE:
Set cRoot = Nothing
Set cNode = Nothing

Exit Sub

Eroare:
    MsgBox Err.Description, vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    Resume IESIRE
End Sub


Private Sub mcTree_NodeCheck(cNode As clsNode)
Dim LunaInchisa As Date
Dim vIDL As Integer: vIDL = cNode.Tag

If cNode.Level <> 1 Then
    cNode.Checked = False
    Exit Sub
End If

LunaInchisa = DateAdd("M", 1, CDate(cNode.ExtraInfo))

If Not cNode.Checked Then
    If CInt(Split(cNode.Key, "_")(1)) <> CInt(DMax("IDL", "LunaD")) - 1 Then
        MsgBox "Poate fi deblocata doar ultima luna inchisa!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
        cNode.Checked = True
    Else
        If MsgBox("Prin deblocarea lunii " & cNode.Caption & " vei sterge TOATE datele lunii curente!" & vbCrLf & "Doresti sa continui?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbNo Then Exit Sub
        If InputBoxDK("Tasteaza parola pentru deblocare luna!", "CLng(Date)", "") <> CLng(Date) Then Exit Sub
        CurrentDb.Execute "DELETE * FROM Prezenta WHERE IDL = " & vIDL + 1
        CurrentDb.Execute "DELETE * FROM LunaD WHERE IDL = " & vIDL + 1
        CurrentDb.Execute "DELETE * FROM [SS_Buget] WHERE IDL = " & vIDL
        CurrentDb.Execute "UPDATE LunaD SET Inchisa=False WHERE IDL=" & vIDL
        LunaD_2_LunaD_L
        Pop_luni

    End If
Else
    If MsgBox("Doresti blocarea lunii " & cNode.Caption & " si deschiderea lunii " & fLuna(Month(LunaInchisa)) & "/" & Year(LunaInchisa) & "?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbNo Then Exit Sub
    If InchideLuna(LunaInchisa) Then
        MsgBox "Datele au fost transferate cu succes in luna " & LunaInchisa & "!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
        LunaD_2_LunaD_L
        Pop_luni
    End If
End If

End Sub


Private Sub mcTree_Click(cNode As clsNode)
If Split(cNode.Key, "_")(0) = "L" Then
    Me.IDL = Split(cNode.Key, "_")(1)
    Me.IDV = cNode.ExtraInfoNumber
    Me.Inchisa = cNode.Checked
    Me.Luna = DLookup("Luna", "LunaD_L", "Idl=" & IDL)
    Me.Anul = DLookup("Anul", "LunaD_L", "Idl=" & IDL)
    
    Forms!prezenta!IDL = IDL
    Forms!prezenta!IDV = IDV
    
    Forms!prezenta!CautT.Enabled = True
    Forms!prezenta!CAUT.Enabled = True
    Forms!prezenta!CautB.Enabled = True
    
    Forms!prezenta!cIDV.Enabled = Not cNode.Checked
    Forms!prezenta!cIDV = cNode.ExtraInfoNumber

    Forms!prezenta!Rapoarte!DI = Format("01/" & Me.Luna & "/" & Me.Anul, "Short Date")
    Forms!prezenta!Rapoarte!DSF = dhLastDayInMonth(Format("01/" & Me.Luna & "/" & Me.Anul, "Short Date"))

    Call IncarcaGrupe
    
    Call IncarcaPrezenta(True)
    
    Plati.SourceObject = "Plati_chitante"
    Tb = 0
End If

End Sub

Sub LunaD_2_LunaD_L()
Dim RC As DAO.Recordset, TC As DAO.Recordset

CurrentDb.Execute "DELETE * FROM LunaD_L"

Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("LunaD_L", 2)
Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT lunad.IDL, lunad.Idv, lunad.Luna, lunad.Anul, lunad.LunaT, lunad.LA, lunad.inchisa FROM lunad;", 2)

Do While Not RC.EOF
    TC.AddNew
        TC!IDL = RC!IDL
        TC!Luna = RC!Luna
        TC!Anul = RC!Anul
        TC!LunaT = RC!LunaT
        TC!LA = RC!LA
        TC!IDV = RC!IDV
        TC!Inchisa = RC!Inchisa
    TC.Update
    RC.MoveNext
Loop

Set RC = Nothing
Set TC = Nothing

End Sub

Sub IncarcaGrupe()

Forms!prezenta!Grupe!GE.visible = True

CurrentDb.Execute "DELETE * FROM Grupe_L"

Dim RC As Recordset, TC As Recordset
Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("Grupe_L", 2)

If Me.Inchisa = True Then
    Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT IDG, Grupa, Educator FROM SS_Buget WHERE IDL = " & Me.IDL & " GROUP BY IDG, Grupa, Educator ORDER BY IDG;", 2)
Else
    Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT Grupe.IDg, Grupe.Grupa, grupe.educator FROM Grupe;", 2)
End If
   
Do While Not RC.EOF
    TC.AddNew
        TC!IDG = RC!IDG
        TC!Grupa = RC!Grupa
        TC!Educator = RC!Educator
    TC.Update
    RC.MoveNext
Loop

Set RC = Nothing
Set TC = Nothing

Forms!prezenta!Grupe.Requery

End Sub

Private Function InchideLuna(Dt As Date) As Boolean
On Error GoTo Eroare

InchideLuna = False

If ECount("IDG", "(SELECT IDG FROM SS_Buget WHERE IDL = " & Me.IDL - 2 & " GROUP BY IDG)") <> 0 Then
    If ECount("IDG", "(SELECT IDG FROM SS_Buget WHERE IDL = " & Me.IDL - 2 & " GROUP BY IDG)") > ECount("IDG", "(SELECT IDG FROM Prezenta WHERE IDL = " & Me.IDL & " GROUP BY IDG)") Then
        If MsgBox("In luna anterioara exista mai multe grupe cu prezenta decat in luna curenta!" & vbCrLf & "Este corect?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbNo Then Exit Function
    End If
End If

Dim Wk As DAO.Workspace
Dim RC As DAO.Recordset
Dim tIDL As Integer

Set Wk = Workspaces(0)

Wk.BeginTrans

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM LunaD WHERE IDL = " & Me.IDL, 2)
If Not RC.EOF Then
    tIDL = RC!IDL - 1
    
    RC.Edit
        RC!Inchisa = True
    RC.Update
    
    Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM LunaD_L WHERE IDL = " & IDL, 2)
    RC.Edit
        RC!Inchisa = True
    RC.Update

    If tIDL <> 0 Then
        If Not CalculSituatieDebitori_Buget2021(True, True, tIDL) Then
            Wk.Rollback
            InchideLuna = False
            GoTo IESIRE
        Else
            If Not DeschideLuna(Dt) Then
                Wk.Rollback
                InchideLuna = False
                GoTo IESIRE
            Else
                Wk.CommitTrans
                InchideLuna = True
            End If
        End If
    Else
        InchideLuna = False
        Wk.Rollback
    End If
Else
    MsgBox "Luna selectata nu a putut fi inchisa!" & vbCrLf & "Contacteaza autorul!", vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    Wk.Rollback
    InchideLuna = False
End If

IESIRE:
Set RC = Nothing
Set Wk = Nothing

Exit Function

Eroare:
    MsgBox Err.Description, vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    Wk.Rollback
    Resume IESIRE
End Function

Private Function DeschideLuna(Dt As Date) As Boolean
On Error GoTo Eroare
DeschideLuna = False

Dim RC As DAO.Recordset, TC As DAO.Recordset
Dim Wk As DAO.Workspace
Dim WrkDayz As Integer, MaxIDZ As Long, i As Integer

Set Wk = Workspaces(0)

'If DCount("IDL", "LunaD", "Inchisa=False") <> 0 Then
'    MsgBox "Pentru a adauga o luna noua, luna anterioara trebuie sa fie inchisa!" & vbCrLf & "Apasa pe lacat!", vbOKOnly + vbCritical
'    Exit Function
'End If

IDL = CDbl(Nz(DMax("IDL", "LunaD_L", "IDL>0"), 0)) + 1
IDV = CDbl(Nz(DLookup("IDV", "ValoriTaxe", "Activ=True"), 0))

Wk.BeginTrans

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("LunaD")

RC.AddNew
    RC!IDL = IDL
    RC!IDV = IDV
    RC!Luna = Month(Dt)
    RC!Anul = Year(Dt)
    RC!LunaT = fLuna(RC!Luna)
    RC!LA = IIf(Len(RC!Luna) = 1, "0", "") & RC!Luna & RC!Anul
RC.Update

Forms!prezenta!IDL = IDL
Forms!prezenta!IDV = IDV

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT Platitori.IDG, Platitori.IDP FROM Platitori WHERE Platitori.Plecat=False;", 2)
Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("Prezenta", 2)

If Not POP(RC) Then
    MsgBox "A aparut o eroare la preluarea generala!" & vbCrLf & "Este necesar sa o realizezi manual!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

WrkDayz = Work_Days(Dt, CDate(Format(dhLastDayInMonth(Dt), "Short Date")))
MaxIDZ = DMax("IDZ", "Prezenta")

For i = 1 To RC.RecordCount
    TC.AddNew
        TC!IDZ = MaxIDZ + i
        TC!IDG = RC!IDG
        TC!IDP = RC!IDP
        TC!IDL = IDL
        TC!IDV = IDV
        TC!ZileLuna = WrkDayz
        TC!ZilePrezenta = 0
        TC!ZileAbsenta = 0
    TC.Update
       
    RC.MoveNext
Next i

DeschideLuna = True

Wk.CommitTrans

Pop_luni

MsgBox "Datele au fost transferate cu succes!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation

IESIRE:
Set RC = Nothing
Set TC = Nothing
Set Wk = Nothing

Exit Function

Eroare:
    DeschideLuna = False
    MsgBox Err.Description, vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    Wk.Rollback
    Resume IESIRE
End Function
